result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where delivery metadata text overlaps under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text elements overlap, making both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee in a properly spaced inline flex/flow container with a separator dot (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') instead of overlapping absolute positions.
